title: Predator Countdown
desc: Take a trip to Africa, where the law of the jungle prevails and allows curious minds to observe the lives of lions, crocodiles and cheetahs.

title: Wild Wild Bunch
desc: Experts analyse the methods that animal delinquents use to create fear and chaos.

title: Bastion of the Giants
desc: An engrossing journey into the lives of Asian Elephants, and the stunning bio-diverse North Eastern jungles of India around the river Brahmaputra.

title: Africa's Hunters
desc: An intimate insight into the lives of the prominent wild predators of Africa as they face their daily struggles.

title: Sri Lanka - Leopards Of Yala
desc: Follow the trials and tribulations of a group of leopards in Yala National Park.

title: Big Cat Tales
desc: A dispersed Marsh Pride faces weakened protection from the six male warrior lions. Plus, a cheetah works tirelessly to raise her three new cubs.

title: Race of Life
desc: Desert animals have evolved to handle heat and lack of water. This includes scorpions, which have existed since life first crawled from the sea.

title: Race of Life
desc: The African Savannah sees thousands of battles each day. Learn how elephants survive on a diet that even the strictest vegetarian would avoid.

title: Wild Assassins
desc: Explores how the most venomous creatures, including Sydney Funnel Web spider and the Diamondback rattlesnake, hunt their preys and survive in the wild.

title: White Wolves: Ghosts of the Arctic
desc: Ellesmere Island, situated at Canada's northernmost edge, is home to a family of wolves who desperately attempt to raise their pups in the unforgiving environment.

title: Wolves & Lions: Old Enemies
desc: In Africa, lions and wolves lead their ecosystems. Discover the strength, social strategies and hierarchies behind how they raise and protect their young.

title: Creative Killers
desc: The filmmaker follows wildebeests and zebras circling East Africa looking for lush grazing and sheds light on the hungry river crocodiles who lie in wait for this movable feast.

title: Brotherhood of Lions
desc: The young males of the lion pride must form a coalition to work together against their rivals, but they first need to leave their mothers at two years old and fend for themselves.

title: Surviving Earth
desc: A protective mother amphibian battles to keep her brood of eggs in water while the forest around her dries out and the trees collapse.
